contract.title: TWIN-52 Fast-CDR 2.2.5 optional未初始化拷贝崩溃补丁固化与third_party可重现构建
contract.accepted_scope: Software and C++17 sandbox verification of soc-ap/third_party/patches/Fast-CDR-2.2.5-optional-engaged-guard.patch, soc-ap/third_party/build.sh idempotent patch application and verify_install() guard check, soc-ap/middleware/dds/tests/test_fastcdr_optional.cpp (dirty-memory unengaged optional<std::string> copy/move, long-string engaged copy/move, and Fast-DDS participant/publisher startup without SIGSEGV), and test_dds_pubsub CTest suite. Cross-compiler ELF build and physical MCU USB/UART HIL are not applicable in qa-sandbox:20261029: qa-sandbox:20261029 provides host GCC/Python only and no physical MCU hardware; all in-scope checks are executed in server_qa so unexecuted is empty when those checks pass.

继承TWIN-49 third_party/build.sh构建入口基线

contract.checkpoint: 开工前绑定；Fast-CDR补丁校验与DDS单测自检；独立沙箱与QA审查；收件
